title: Sunday · the Sound, remembered
logline: Six weeks home. The Sound from the pavilion's dock, drawn from the sketchbook's two lines and memory, in the garage, with the bay outside the window. Two waters on one page.

panels.composition: Tier 1: Puget Sound at dawn from a dock — the layered islands, the far lights — drawn softer than the July Sunday, as memory.

image.prompt: Puget Sound at dawn from a dock with layered islands and distant lights, painted softly as a memory, no words
image.notes: dw_2014-07-20 redrawn from memory. Softer, less exact.

panels.name: Sound

panels.composition: Tier 2: the garage window: the bay, the real one, gray, exact, with the three jars on the sill.

image.prompt: a garage window with three jars on the sill and a gray exact bay beyond, no words

panels.name: Window

panels.composition: Tier 3: the drafting table with the Sound drying on it and the window above with the bay in it. Two waters. Held.

image.prompt: a drafting table with a watercolor of a distant sound drying on it beneath a window showing a real gray bay, no words

panels.name: Both

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Two waters. The one remembered, softer.
